R5-1: closed — "AutoPay debit" is defined by the AutoPay channel the ledger records (and its return by the return line that reverses it and carries that channel), stated in every sentence that uses it and computed that way in the goodwill gate and base tier, the re-enrollment scope and return count, and both reliefs' AutoPay timing tiers; the seeded return lines carry the reversed payment's channel and due date.
R5-2: closed — a debit card payment is netted only of its own chargeback (the CB return that reverses that payment) in the late fee and the settlement alike; an unrelated chargeback no longer reduces the late-fee credit.
